# A target the fold turns into a cross-reference to itself

The entry is written at three levels, its third carrying a comma; the target is
written at four, and folding it produces exactly that third level. So the fold
makes the target name the entry it is written on, and the target is dropped —
one report about that, and no report announcing a path the target now names,
because there is no surviving target to announce. Two reports about one target,
each contradicting the other, is the defect this whole milestone removes, and
it is reachable from the fold's own report just as it was from the
format-neutral one (M18 review F1).

Nothing in the two fold fixtures reaches this: their fold-self shapes are
written at three levels, so the report about a rewritten target never fires on
them, and their rewritten targets all survive the fold.
